# Palle Mark Christensen

Palle Mark Christensen is a general practitioner (praktiserende læge) at Lægerne Lærkevej in Otterup, Denmark [^src1][^src2]. He is named as a member of the steering committee (styregruppe) for the AFDK (Atrieflimren Danmark) national quality database, which tracks and reports on atrial fibrillation care across Denmark [^src1][^src2].

He appears in the steering committee listings of two consecutive AFDK annual reports: the report covering 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023 [^src1], and the following year's report [^src2]. In both cases, the entry simply identifies him by profession and practice location, with no further biographical or role detail provided in the source material.

The chapters in which he is listed describe the AFDK database's data foundation, patient-population definitions, data-collection limitations, and the composition of its steering group, as well as regional atrial fibrillation incidence data across Denmark's five regions [^src1]. The 2024 report section additionally covers patient representatives' perspectives on structured patient education and the steering committee's membership, within AFDK's role as a nationwide quality database operating under the Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab and approved by Sundhedsstyrelsen [^src2].

No relationships, claims, or timeline events involving Palle Mark Christensen are documented in the available corpus beyond his listed committee membership and practice affiliation.
